definitions.explanation: A humorous drawing that exaggerates or makes fun of its subject. Best known from the 12th–13th-century scrolls {鳥獣戯画|ちょうじゅうぎが}, often called Japan's first manga.

examples.japanese: {戯画|ぎが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
{鳥獣戯画|ちょうじゅうぎが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧だ。
examples.english: The Chōjū-giga scrolls are a National Treasure.

examples.japanese: {鳥獣戯画|ちょうじゅうぎが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ウサギや⟦カエル→カエル：28199_kaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: In the Chōjū-giga, rabbits and frogs are shown playing as if they were human.

notes:
{戯|ぎ} (play, jest) + {画|が} (picture). A literary and art-history word; also used of writing or acts that turn something into a caricature ({戯画化|ぎがか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥獣戯画|ちょうじゅうぎが}: the Chōjū-giga animal scrolls at Kōzan-ji, Kyoto
- {戯画化|ぎがか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to caricature, to make a caricature of
- {戯画的|ぎがてき}な: caricatured, cartoonish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風刺画|ふうしが}→風刺画：21972_fuushiga⟧: satirical cartoon — stresses criticism, while {戯画|ぎが} stresses humor
- ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧: manga, comics — the everyday modern word
- カリカチュア: caricature — the loanword
